name: job-application-agent
description: AI job-application agent run as a service: finds jobs that fit each user's CV across ~16,000 Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workable boards, tailors the CV and cover letter, submits the form, and tracks every application in a web dashboard. Python, Playwright, Cloudflare Workers, Neon Postgres, GitHub Actions. (source private).

paragraphs: A web app that finds jobs that fit each user's CV, tailors a CV and cover letter to every one, fills in and submits the application on the employer's own site, and tracks every application. Users sign in, upload their CV once and bring their own free AI key; JobBot applies for them through the working day.
Live at jobbotapp.pages.dev, with a free trial: 10 applications within 3 days, no card needed.

About this repository. It documents the project: what it does, how it's built, its safeguards and a product video. The source code is private because it handles users' CVs, contact details and application histories. To see it working, try it live, book a demo or email hksahni0@gmail.com.
